title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Watching the score
hook: Do you know the score right now, or are you watching the kids?
intro: You catch yourself counting runs instead of watching players.
statement: Where your attention goes, your coaching follows.
q1: Do you track the score closely during games —
q2: or let it go and watch how kids are playing?
q3: What do you notice when you stop counting?
t1: Every coach is different. But you see more
t2: when the score is not the only thing you watch.
cta: Coaches — do you track the score?
ctaLines: Score in my head. A parent keeps it. I let it go.
Watch the score or watch the kids?
ctaPrompt: Share your game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you know the score right now, or are you watching the kids?
The game is close. You catch yourself counting runs instead of watching players.
Where your attention goes, your coaching follows.
Track the score or let it go. Every team is different.
Do you track the score? Share your habit in the comments.
